about: The platform rule of every RRP the packs configure (scripts/trustzone.py; the gateways' PlatformPolicy, rrp/internal/gateway/platform.go): what a verified, affirming Attestation Result must also report about the platform. trust/README.md gives the reason for each value, and what a bank would require instead.

sources.snp: AMD-SB-3034 (CVE-2025-54510): Milan 'TCB[SNP]>=0x1D', Genoa (EPYC 8004 and 9004) 'TCB[SNP]>=0x1C', Turin (EPYC 9005) 'TCB[SNP]>=0x5'. https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3034.html, as the Internet Archive kept it: https://web.archive.org/web/20260710223106id_/https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3034.html
sources.ucode: AMD-SB-3027 (CVE-2025-29943): Milan B1 'TCB[MICROCODE] >= DE', Genoa 'TCB[MICROCODE] >= 56', Turin C1 'TCB[MICROCODE] >= 51' (hex). https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3027.html, as the Internet Archive kept it: https://web.archive.org/web/20260710223108id_/https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3027.html
sources.bl: Google Cloud security bulletin GCP-2025-007 (CVE-2024-56161, AMD-SB-3019): the minimum TCB of its SEV-SNP hosts names 'psp_bootloader_version: 4'. https://cloud.google.com/support/bulletins#gcp-2025-007 (page read 29.09.2026). The AMD bulletins read for these floors (AMD-SB-3015, 3019, 3020, 3027 and 3034) give none for the bootloader or the TEE.
sources.hosts: What the hardware runs of 7 October 2026 reported, decoded from the Attestation Results in their Veraison logs (e2e/evidence/20261007T045034Z-gcp-sev-snp-e2e-passport, …045331Z-aws-sev-snp-e2e-passport): EPYC Milan (CPUID family 0x19, model 0x01), SMT enabled, ALIAS_CHECK_COMPLETE set. GCP, VCEK-signed with CHIP_ID: REPORTED_TCB and COMMITTED_TCB bl 4, tee 0, snp 29, ucode 222. AWS, VLEK-signed without CHIP_ID: REPORTED_TCB bl 4, tee 0, snp 29, ucode 222; COMMITTED_TCB bl 4, tee 0, snp 31, ucode 225. Their reports' mitigation vectors, 28 September to 7 October 2026: GCP 0xb; AWS 0xf, 0x10f or 0xfef; none sets bit 4, which AMD-SB-3034 names for Milan (docs/limits.md).
sources.tdx: The TD ATTRIBUTES the bench's TDX verifier refuses by default (rrp/cmd/tdx-verifier/main.go): the TUP group, bits 15:4, and MIGRATABLE, bit 29; the gateways always refuse the TUD group, bits 3:0, a TD under debug. Checked again by the RRP, so that it does not rest on the verifier's configuration. The GCP TDs of the hardware runs have ATTRIBUTES 0x10000000, SEPT_VE_DISABLE only (rrp/cmd/tdx-verifier/main_test.go).
sources.platform_info_bits: AMD-SB-3015 (CVE-2024-21944) gives, for Milan and Genoa, PLATFORM_INFO bit 5, ALIAS_CHECK_COMPLETE, as the attestation evidence that alias detection completed and found no aliasing addresses. https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3015.html, as the Internet Archive kept it: https://web.archive.org/web/20260710223038id_/https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3015.html
sources.mitigation_bits: AMD-SB-3020 (CVE-2025-0033) names 'SEV Mitigation Vector Bit' 1 for Milan and Genoa and 0 for Turin, in its table of fixes; AMD-SB-3034 (CVE-2025-54510) gives Milan's attestation value as 'TCB[SNP]>=0x1D mitigation bit = 4'. https://web.archive.org/web/20260710222907id_/https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3020.html, https://web.archive.org/web/20260710223106id_/https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3034.html. Every host the bench has met sets bit 1; none sets bit 4, so this rule refuses every SEV-SNP host the bench has met. The bench's own pack admits them under a named waiver that every run records (packs/tacra-bench, platform_waivers); the Demo Bank's pack, a bank's, names none and refuses them (docs/limits.md).
